newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps rates Suzano export certificates.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps rates Suzano export certificates.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it assigned a triple-B-minus rating to the $100 million in Brazil's Companhia Suzano de Papel e Celulose SA export trust certificates.
Duff & Phelps said the rating is based on the credit quality of Suzano, the strength of Suzano's pulp and paper export business and the structure of the certificates.
Potential corporate risks include the cyclical nature of the industry, a downturn in the Brazilian paper market and the continued cash support from its subsidiary, the rating company said.
